import pyautogui, time, subprocess
text = """Year\tCA changes\tFA changes\tOA changes
2015\t=(Sheet1.B3-Sheet1.B2)/Sheet1.B2\t=(Sheet1.C3-Sheet1.C2)/Sheet1.C2\t=(Sheet1.D3-Sheet1.D2)/Sheet1.D2
2016\t=(Sheet1.B4-Sheet1.B3)/Sheet1.B3\t=(Sheet1.C4-Sheet1.C3)/Sheet1.C3\t=(Sheet1.D4-Sheet1.D3)/Sheet1.D3
2017\t=(Sheet1.B5-Sheet1.B4)/Sheet1.B4\t=(Sheet1.C5-Sheet1.C4)/Sheet1.C4\t=(Sheet1.D5-Sheet1.D4)/Sheet1.D4
2018\t=(Sheet1.B6-Sheet1.B5)/Sheet1.B5\t=(Sheet1.C6-Sheet1.C5)/Sheet1.C5\t=(Sheet1.D6-Sheet1.D5)/Sheet1.D5
2019\t=(Sheet1.B7-Sheet1.B6)/Sheet1.B6\t=(Sheet1.C7-Sheet1.C6)/Sheet1.C6\t=(Sheet1.D7-Sheet1.D6)/Sheet1.D6"""
subprocess.run(['bash','-lc', "cat > /tmp/calc_paste.txt <<'EOF'\n"+text+"\nEOF\nxclip -selection clipboard /tmp/calc_paste.txt"], check=False)
pyautogui.click(151,315)
